teaser.en: The 'small rib plant', linked by name and use to nyuni wa mbavu, the convulsions that Digo belief ties to certain birds.
teaser.sw: 'Mmea mdogo wa mbavu', unaohusishwa kwa jina na matumizi na nyuni wa mbavu, degedege ambalo imani ya Kidigo inalihusisha na ndege fulani.
teaser.dg: 'Mmea mdide wa mbavu', unaoungwa kpwa dzina na kpwa matumizi na *nyuni wa mbavu*, ukongo wa ana adide wa kugbwa na kukakama ambao Adigo anaamini unarehwa ni ndege anjina.

summary.en: Mbavubavu mdide is an aromatic, much-branched shrub of dry bush. It is paired by name with the 'large' mbavubavu, Grewia forbesii, because both are used against the convulsions called nyuni wa mbavu.
summary.sw: Mbavubavu mdide ni kichaka chenye harufu nzuri na matawi mengi kinachoota vichakani mahali pakavu. Kimeoanishwa kwa jina na mbavubavu 'mkubwa', Grewia forbesii, kwa sababu vyote viwili hutumika dhidi ya degedege liitwalo nyuni wa mbavu.
summary.dg: *Mbavubavu mdide* ni chitsaka chenye arufu nono na panda nyinji, cha weruni kpwenye tsi kavu. Kpwa dzina unaikpwa phamwenga na *mbavubavu mkulu*, *Grewia forbesii*, kpwa sababu yosi miiri nkuhumirwa kuhenda dawa ya ukongo wa *nyuni* unaoihwa *nyuni wa mbavu*.

about.en: Mbavubavu mdide is a much-branched shrub one to four metres tall. Its older stems are square in section, and its thin whitish-brown bark peels in strips. The leaves grow in opposite pairs, sometimes in fours of two large and two small. They are oval, up to 7 cm long, dotted with glands on both sides, and give off a spicy smell when crushed. Small greenish-white flowers are borne in loose heads at the branch tips. They are followed by pea-sized red-purple to black fruits, each sitting in the enlarged green cup of the calyx.
about.sw: Mbavubavu mdide ni kichaka chenye matawi mengi, chenye urefu wa mita moja hadi nne. Mashina yake ya zamani yana pembe nne yakikatwa, na gome lake jembamba la rangi ya hudhurungi-nyeupe hubambuka kwa vipande virefu. Majani huota kwa jozi zinazotazamana, wakati mwingine manne pamoja, mawili makubwa na mawili madogo. Yana umbo la yai, urefu wa hadi sentimita 7, yana vitone vya tezi pande zote mbili, na hutoa harufu ya viungo yakipondwa. Maua madogo meupe-kijani huota katika vichwa vilivyolegea kwenye ncha za matawi. Hufuatwa na matunda ya ukubwa wa njegere, mekundu-zambarau hadi meusi, kila moja likikaa ndani ya kikombe cha kijani cha kalisi kilichopanuka.
about.dg: *Mbavubavu mdide* ni chitsaka chenye panda nyinji, chinachofika mita mwenga hadi nne dzulu. Mihiye ya kare ina pembe nne, na gophare rembamba ra rangi nyereru na ya dongo rinabambandzuka kpwa vipande vire. Makodzage ganamera jozi-jozi ganalolana, na wakati wanjina manne-manne: mairi makulu na mairi madide. Gana umbo ra mviringo, ni mare hadi sentimita 7, gana madowa madide ga *glands* dzulu na photsi, na gachihopezwa ganalavya arufu kali na nono. Maruwa madide ga rangi nyereru na chijani chidide ganamera kpwa makundi gasigobanana, kpwenye ntsa za panda. Badaye kunazuka matunda ga ukulu wa tembe ya mbalazi, ga kundu na zambarau hadi maru, na chila tunda rinakala ndani ya chikombe cha chijani cha *calyx*, chiricho chikakula.

where.en: It is a common shrub of the drier lowlands, in dry bushland and thicket on the coast and further inland.
where.sw: Ni kichaka cha kawaida cha nyanda za chini zilizo kavu zaidi, katika vichaka vikavu na vichaka vizito pwani na ndani zaidi bara.
where.dg: Ni chitsaka cha kawaida cha tsi za photsi kavu, chinachomera weruni kpwenye tsi kavu na vitsakani, pwani na bara.

uses.en: According to ICRAF, the shrub is used across Kenya for firewood, tool handles and arrows. The leaves and roots are used in medicine, the fruit is eaten in small amounts, the leaves are browsed by goats and camels, and the flowers are good for bees. Its Digo name points to a medicinal use against *nyuni wa mbavu*, a form of convulsion.
uses.sw: Kwa mujibu wa ICRAF, kichaka hiki hutumika kote Kenya kwa kuni, mipini ya zana na mishale. Majani na mizizi hutumika katika dawa, tunda huliwa kwa kiasi kidogo, majani huliwa na mbuzi na ngamia, na maua ni mazuri kwa nyuki. Jina lake la Kidigo linaashiria matumizi ya dawa dhidi ya *nyuni wa mbavu*, aina ya degedege.
uses.dg: ICRAF inagomba kukala chitsaka hichi nkuhumirwa Kenya yosi kpwa kuni, miphini ya vyombo na mivi. Makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa, matunda nkuriwa chidide, makodza nkuriwa ni mbuzi na ngamia, na maruwa ni manono kpwa nyuchi. Dzinare ra Chidigo rinaonyesa kukala nkuhumirwa dza dawa ya *nyuni wa mbavu*, aina ya ukongo wa kugbwa na kukakama.

culture.en: Pakia explains the 'rib' (*mbavu*) in the name through its use. This shrub and *Grewia forbesii* (*mbavubavu mkulu*) are both used to treat the convulsions known as *nyuni wa mbavu*. Mgombato describes *nyuni* as a convulsion affecting young children, believed to be caused by the appearance of certain birds. Its relatives *Premna chrysoclada* (*mvuma*) and *P. hildebrandtii* (*muurusa pungu*) are also Digo remedies against convulsions.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza 'mbavu' (*mbavu*) katika jina kupitia matumizi yake. Kichaka hiki na *Grewia forbesii* (*mbavubavu mkulu*) vyote hutumika kutibu degedege linalojulikana kama *nyuni wa mbavu*. Mgombato inaeleza *nyuni* kama degedege linalowapata watoto wadogo, linaloaminiwa kusababishwa na kutokea kwa ndege fulani. Ndugu zake *Premna chrysoclada* (*mvuma*) na *P. hildebrandtii* (*muurusa pungu*) pia ni dawa za Kidigo dhidi ya degedege.
culture.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala neno 'mbavu' (*mbavu*) kpwenye dzina hiri rinalavywa kula matumiziye. Chitsaka hichi na *Grewia forbesii* (*mbavubavu mkulu*) vyosi nkuhumirwa kuhenda dawa ya ukongo unaoihwa *nyuni wa mbavu*. Mgombato inaandika *nyuni* kukala ni ukongo wa ana adide wa kugbwa na kukakama, ambao atu anaamini unarehwa ni kuonekana kpwa ndege anjina. Nduguze *Premna chrysoclada* (*mvuma*) na *P. hildebrandtii* (*muurusa pungu*) piya ni dawa za Chidigo za ukongo wa kugbwa na kukakama.

names.en: Digo: *mbavubavu mdide*, 'small rib plant'. It is 'small' (*-dide*) compared with *mbavubavu mkulu*, because its leaves are smaller. ICRAF gives different Digo names for this species, *mursapungu* and *mvuma*. Pakia uses those names for two other *Premna* species. Mgombato uses *m'bavu-bavu* for yet another plant, *Clerodendrum capitatum*. Swahili: *mvumba ngombe* (ICRAF).
names.sw: Kidigo: *mbavubavu mdide*, 'mmea mdogo wa mbavu'. Ni 'mdogo' (*-dide*) ukilinganishwa na *mbavubavu mkulu*, kwa sababu majani yake ni madogo zaidi. ICRAF inatoa majina tofauti ya Kidigo kwa spishi hii, *mursapungu* na *mvuma*. Pakia anatumia majina hayo kwa spishi nyingine mbili za *Premna*. Mgombato inatumia *m'bavu-bavu* kwa mmea mwingine kabisa, *Clerodendrum capitatum*. Kiswahili: *mvumba ngombe* (ICRAF).
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mbavubavu mdide*, 'mmea mdide wa mbavu'. Ni 'mdide' (*-dide*) kuriko *mbavubavu mkulu*, kpwa sababu makodzage ni madide zaidi. ICRAF inapha madzina ganjina ga Chidigo kpwa aina ihi, *mursapungu* na *mvuma*. Pakia anahumira madzina higo kpwa aina mbiri zanjina za *Premna*. Mgombato inahumira *m'bavu-bavu* kpwa mmea wanjina tsona, *Clerodendrum capitatum*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mvumba ngombe* (ICRAF).
